patch.value: Retain validation checkpoints only while native semantic scope is unchanged
Attach deterministic core-assurance receipt bindings to stable native changes; recheck selected record fields and explicit policy dependencies during inspection and receiver publication.

Irrelevant edits retain valid evidence; relevant edits invalidate it; publication cannot substitute an old claim for the changed scope. Typed SDK and CLI, compact TOON/JSON, typed refusals with remedies, README example, non-git regression and read-only public-tracker measurements, npm and Bun CI release gates.
